notes: §1985:IX.2.3.4 GR1: "all file control entries in the run unit which reference this file connector must have" the same OPTIONAL phrase, a consistent ASSIGN, the same RESERVE integer-1, organization, access mode, prime-key entry and location, and alternate keys (count, entries, locations, DUPLICATES). Since PB5069 landed, BinderDriver.Bind calls ExternalFileConnectorRules.Check at every edition; it groups the compilation group's EXTERNAL files by external name and compares each entry's FileEntryIdentity.Segments with the first describer's (COBOL6847), and imposes the 2023-only FILE STATUS item (COBOL1573/1624) only under DialectLevel >= 2023. Probed at 85 (classes b, e, c, d) with an indexed EXTERNAL file written by MAINPGM and read by SUBPGM, nested and as sibling programs: agreeing entries run (ALPHA, MAIN DONE); each item violated in turn is refused with COBOL6847 naming the clause: a OPTIONAL omitted, b ASSIGN "OTHERDATA", c RESERVE 3 and RESERVE omitted against 2, d RELATIVE, e RANDOM, f prime key moved after the alternate key and re-described PIC 9(4), g alternate key without DUPLICATES and alternate key count 0 (also between sibling programs); a non-external FILE STATUS in one entry compiles and runs at 85 (ALPHA 00) and is refused at 2023 (COBOL1624, COBOL1573). The witness runs two agreeing entries through both keys. Cross-compilation-unit agreement is checked only by the run time's EC-EXTERNAL-FILE-MISMATCH, which 1985 does not require. || REFUTED: PARTIAL (harm: over-rejects): an external indexed file whose describers list the same alternate keys in a different order is refused with COBOL6847 at every edition; the ALT segment of FileEntryIdentity.Segments should compare the alternate keys as a set (sorted by key entry), as COLL already does. Repro: refute-rs-01/x_swapalt.cob. kb/Work PB5567 holds the defect (code read: op-20261114/out-reread5/rs-01.json, refuter op-20261114/out-reread5/rs-01-refute.json; rerun op-20261114/records-rs5a/rerun-log.txt). The same access mode."; 2023: "i) The same specification of the FILE STATUS clause, where data-name-4 shall reference the same corresponding external data item.". 2023 keeps 1985 items a-g but also requires the same FILE STATUS clause, referencing the same external item, across entries. 1985 placed no such limit, so 2023 refuses programs 1985 accepted.
